notes.title: 250ms2 is Coming Soon – The Sequel Awaits!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]Thank you to all who have played [i]250ms[/i]. We are pleased to announce that the sequel, [b]250ms2[/b], is scheduled for release on [b]September 9, 2025[/b].[/p][p][b]250ms2[/b] will return with improved features and brand-new themed stages, delivering an even more refined gameplay experience.[/p][p]We look forward to your continued interest and support, and we invite you to visit the store page for more details.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support. — BMSgames[/p]
